headline: Silver Fell 1.51 Percent to .23 as Oil Rose 1.19 Percent
narrative: Silver dropped 1.51 percent to .23 while gold eased 0.26 percent to ,179.70, money leaving the precious-metals pipe. Oil rose 1.19 percent to .86, the energy pipe taking the bid the metals gave up. Ethereum sat at 0.983 times its 200-week average and Solana at 0.95 times, both on the long-term floor, while Solana longs ran a 2.41 ratio, the 90th percentile of the 30-day range.
author: jordan
